resources.string: Power on one Muse, select its model, and connect. The proof is complete only when BrainFlow receives EEG samples. After sixteen seconds, the app adds edge-safe brainwave powerbands and a smoothed relaxation score. The optional device name must exactly match the BLE name, such as MuseS-XXXX.
Ready. Power on a Muse and tap Connect & stream.
BrainFlow is scanning for and connecting to the Muse over BLE…
Connected and streaming. Waiting for the first EEG packet…
VERIFIED: live Muse EEG samples received over BLE through BrainFlow.
Connected, but no EEG packets arrived in 10 seconds. Check headset power and retry.
Stopping stream and releasing the BrainFlow session…
Ten-second rolling analysis, refreshed once per second with a three-second right-context delay. Keep still and wear the sensors firmly for more meaningful feedback.
Collecting clean analysis context: %1$.1f / %2$d s (%3$d s analysis + %4$d s per edge)

BrainFlow RESTFULNESS • DEFAULT_CLASSIFIER • native default moving average (five predictions) • edge-safe ten-second band powers. Experimental feedback; not a clinical measurement or the proprietary Muse Calm score.

Delta 2–4 Hz, theta 4–8 Hz, alpha 8–13 Hz, beta 13–30 Hz, and gamma 30–45 Hz. Zero-phase filters use sixteen seconds of real data; both three-second edge guards are discarded before the central ten-second PSD.
Collecting sixteen seconds of EEG for edge-safe powerbands…
